greetingLines: Hey there 👋 I'm Mpho's onboarding assistant.
Before we start building anything, I'd love to get to know you and your business properly — kind of like a check-up before a prescription.
It only takes about 3 minutes. Ready?

lines: That's everything I need for now 🎉
Mpho will personally read through this and get back to you shortly.
In the meantime, feel free to look around the rest of the site.

questions.botMessage: Let's start simple — what's your name?
Nice to meet you, {fullName}! Do you have a business or brand name, or are you approaching this as an individual?
And what's your role there?
What's the best email to reach you on?
And a phone number, if you're comfortable sharing one? (optional)
How would you prefer I keep in touch during the project?
What industry or sector are you in?
Quick one — how did you hear about me?
Do you already have a website or system in place? Drop the link if so — otherwise just say 'none'.
What are you hoping I can help with? (pick all that apply)
In your own words — what's the main problem you're trying to solve right now?
questions.placeholder: e.g. "Customers can't order from us online"

questions.botMessage: Who are you building this for? Describe your typical customer or user.
questions.placeholder: Age range, location, habits, whatever comes to mind

questions.botMessage: Any must-have features you already know you want?
questions.placeholder: e.g. online payments, booking calendar, live chat

questions.botMessage: Zooming out — what does success look like in 6–12 months?
questions.placeholder: e.g. "30% more online orders" or "a system my team can finally trust"

questions.botMessage: Where's the business right now?
If your brand were a personality, how would you describe it? (playful, premium, no-nonsense, colours you love, etc.)
Any competitors or websites you admire — or ones you definitely don't want to look like?
What budget range are you working with? This just helps me scope something realistic — no judgment either way.
What's your ideal timeline?
Last logistics question — are you the sole decision maker, or is there a team/committee involved?
Anything else you'd like me to know before we chat properly?
questions.placeholder: Optional — leave blank and hit send if not

questions.botMessage: Last thing — okay if I email you occasional project/portfolio updates?
